build.description: Compile a package to dist/. Upstream workspace dependencies build first.

typecheck.description: tsc -b per package. Cacheable, declares no outputs. Waits for upstream builds and typechecks (tsc -b also builds referenced projects, so they must not run concurrently) and for the tsconfig structure check.

lint.description: Lint a package. Cacheable, declares no outputs; upstream packages build first so type-aware rules see their declarations.

test.description: Unit tests (Vitest). Cacheable; coverage reports are the only outputs. Also runs the scripts/ self-tests.

test:int.description: Integration tests against real services (Testcontainers). Never cached: results depend on external state.

test:e2e.description: End-to-end tests (Playwright) against the compose stack. Never cached: results depend on external state.

dev.description: Long-running dev servers with hot reload. Never cached.

//#check:tsconfig.description: Structural tsconfig/project-reference check (scripts/check-tsconfig.mjs) over every member. Cacheable; hashes every file it reads.

//#test:scripts.description: Self-tests for the repository scripts under scripts/. Never cached: they inspect the live workspace.
